OpenAI just open-sourced something wild: an entire archive of advanced mathematical manuscripts and Lean proof artifacts generated by an unreleased internal model! 🤯

For too long, traditional AI math benchmarks have suffered from saturation. When frontier models are tested only on standard problems, it's hard to measure true reasoning capabilities. 

OpenAI/math solves this by giving us a structured catalog of complex reasoning traces, PDFs, source files, and Lean 4 formalizations tackling actual open research problems. 

Here is what is inside the repository:
📚 719 mathematical manuscripts organized into 372 distinct families across advanced disciplines.
⚙️ Lean interactive theorem prover integration, boasting a ~42% formalization success rate.
🔬 Published reasoning summaries for major open problems, including the irrationality exponent of pi, Mahler conjectures, and the Mézard-Parisi formula.
🛠️ A standardized preprints directory complete with build and verification instructions.

Why should you care? If you are an AI engineer, formal verification nerd, or developer working on automated reasoning, this is gold. You can study raw reasoning traces to see how frontier models break down multi-step logic, and integrate Lean verification pipelines into your own AI agent workflows.

Check out the repo and dive into the code today:
https://github.com/openai/math

Want to run a massive 27B local LLM on a base-tier Mac without hitting memory bottlenecks or sluggish prefill times? 

Meet Backburner: a specialized inference engine built on a custom fork of llama.cpp that transforms your iPhone into a collaborative coprocessor over USB-C. 

By connecting your iPhone via a 10 Gb/s USB-C cable, Backburner lets you distribute heavy compute loads between your Mac and iOS device, helping you run large models faster and with triple the context length—completely off-grid and privacy-first.

Key Features:
- Split Prefill Architecture: Dynamically pipelines prompt ingestion by having the Mac process initial layers and stream residuals to the iPhone to concurrently compute trailing layers, accelerating prefill speeds by 29 to 44 percent.
- Offloaded Extended Context: Expands context windows dramatically beyond local hardware limits (tested up to 128k-140k tokens) by storing older KV cache pages on the iPhone and using its GPU and Neural Engine to compute attention.
- Hardware-Optimized Custom Kernels: Features custom llama.cpp forks implementing Apple SME2 CPU co-attention, Metal tensor core fusions, and DFlash2 speculative decoding.
- Secure USB-C Routing: Restricts communication exclusively to authenticated, encrypted tunnels over the USB-C cable or an authenticated Wi-Fi pairing.

Perfect for AI engineers, local-first developers, and machine learning researchers running autonomous coding agents like Aider or Open Interpreter on consumer Apple hardware. Turn your idle devices into a scalable edge inference cluster without buying an expensive hardware upgrade.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/StayLameBro/backburner

Ready to ditch bloated, closed-source motion graphics software and fragile FFmpeg wrappers? Meet EffectCraft—a pure Rust, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects built for developers, systems programmers, and AI engineers. 🦀✨

For years, the tech and creative community has lacked a modern, fast, open-source, and version-control-friendly visual effects compositor. EffectCraft solves this by rebuilding the entire After Effects ecosystem from scratch in pure Rust. 

Here is what makes it a game-changer for your workflow:
🚀 Complete After Effects parity featuring panels, timelines, 306 effects, layer styles, expressions, classic 3D cameras, lights, and a graph editor.
⚙️ Native Rust media encoding/decoding pipelines handling H.264, ProRes, VP9, AV1, HEVC, and Opus without touching FFmpeg.
🤖 Built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and CLI JSON interface, enabling AI agents and external scripts to control the entire editor programmatically for automated asset generation.
📂 Clean, version-controlled JSON project files (.ecproj) plus native Lottie import and export for seamless web and mobile integration.

Whether you are building automated pipelines to mass-generate personalized video ads using AI agents or constructing high-performance web motion graphics pipelines, EffectCraft delivers native speed and absolute scriptability.

Check out the code, star the repo, and start building today:
https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft

Eleven specialized Claude skills coordinate end-to-end to reverse-engineer, rebuild, and rebrand any software application clean-room style. 🚀

Building a competitive SaaS product usually means weeks of tedious boilerplate, mapping out legacy workflows, and writing baseline architecture specs from scratch. 

Enter Jakeschincariol/replica-skill—an automated, sequential pipeline of eleven Claude AI skills supported by standard-library Python tools. It systematically guides you from reverse-engineering an existing app to architecting, building, testing, rebranding, and deploying a functional clone with distinct positioning. 💡

Key Features:
- Sequential pipeline architecture where each skill reads output from the previous step within a local replica folder.
- Built-in Python utility scripts for layout-only screenshot diffing via edge maps, WCAG contrast checking, and codebase anti-plagiarism sweeping.
- The Entrepreneur workflow, which analyzes G2 and App Store reviews to identify real user pain points and formulate unique product positioning.
- Strict clean-room constraints that rebuild functionality and UX patterns without copying proprietary source code, logos, copy, or private assets.

Whether you are an indie hacker, rapid prototyper, or AI engineer looking to accelerate your product validation cycles, this repository lets you go from a conceptual app reference to a tested, rebranded product live on your domain. ⚡

Give your AI agents deep, ranked local memory over millions of records with a single Rust binary that consumes a fraction of the tokens! 🤖⚡

Building context-aware AI agents often means hitting brutal context window limits, high latency, and massive token costs when relying on raw file grepping or heavy vector databases for exact historical logs. 

Meet Leviathan—a single static binary written in Rust that provides deep, ranked full-text memory for AI agents over massive datasets. It ingests unstructured or structured records into a local SQLite-backed FTS5 index, delivering precise and cited result cards while completely bypassing the token bloat of traditional strategies. 🚀

🔥 Key Features & Developer Value:
• Extreme Token Efficiency: Returns a median of roughly 436 tokens per question at 1 million records compared to over 100k tokens with standard grep strategies (achieving a 99% top-5 relevant record retrieval rate).
• Zero-Runtime-Dependency: Works seamlessly as a local memory layer with no external database overhead.
• Flexible Data Sources: Supports JSONL, JSON, CSV, TSV, SQLite, and external database CLIs via Unix pipes without storing credentials.
• Advanced Search: Built-in smart group resolution with deterministic handling of ambiguous groups, scope filtering, field weighting, and custom ranking boosts.
• Agent Integration: Features optional Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support and agent skill integrations for direct, read-only historical context access.

🛠️ Perfect Use Cases:
• Equipping customer support AI agents with instant access to millions of historical ticket logs and resolutions.
• Providing local offline context search for dev assistants querying large infrastructure logs or database dumps.

Check out the repository and level up your AI memory layer today:
https://github.com/elstongun/leviathan
